name: The Oracle Tree

angles.text: As a druid, you are attuned to sentient plant life and the voices of ancient trees. Communion with the Oracle Tree extends your reverence for nature.

faq.answer: The Oracle Tree is an ancient, sentient tree that can communicate telepathically with those nearby. When it has a message or duty to give, it sheds a piece of bark to draw worthy travelers’ attention.
The Oracle Tree sends its thoughts telepathically instead of speaking aloud. Inspect the fallen bark, and its calm voice enters your mind like a gentle breeze through leaves.
faq.q: How does the Oracle Tree communicate?

faq.answer: The Oracle Tree sheds bark when it has a duty that needs tending. Inspecting the piece lets the tree send its guidance directly to your mind.
faq.q: Why do you need to find the Oracle Tree's bark?

aliases: who sends you to oracle tree
faq.answer: A local overseer or caretaker directs you to the Oracle Tree. They have watched your accomplishments, see that greater duties await, and notice the freshly shed bark.
faq.q: Who directs you to the Oracle Tree?

faq.answer: You make contact with the Oracle Tree by seeking out its bark. Inspecting it opens your mind to the tree’s message and the greater duty it needs completed.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the quest The Oracle Tree?

faq.answer: The Oracle Tree’s shed bark lies on the ground nearby, waiting for someone attuned enough to hear its message.
faq.q: Where is the Oracle Tree bark found?

sections.body: The Oracle Tree watches its surroundings and guides travelers who have proved their mettle. When it needs an agent in the world, it deliberately sheds a piece of bark nearby. Those who notice are called to step forward, for their first duties are finished and greater responsibilities await.
sections.title: A Call to Greater Duties

sections.body: The Oracle Tree reaches the mind through its fallen bark rather than speaking aloud. Examine the piece, and its calm presence washes over you. Its thoughts and desires come like a soft breeze through a canopy of leaves.
sections.title: Communion Through the Bark

summary: A fallen piece of bark draws travelers to the Oracle Tree, where an ancient voice reaches the mind. Its message calls those who have finished their first duties toward greater work.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Oracle Tree
